title: Assessing the Impact of Code Changes on the Fault Localizability of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Applying semantic-preserving mutations (SPMs) such as variable renaming, misleading comments, dead code insertion, and function reordering to assess whether models rely on irrelevant surface-level syntactic cues rather than actual program semantics.

Measuring the fault localization accuracy of LLMs based on the physical location of the fault within the program's lines of code (divided into quartiles: 0-25%, 25-50%, 50-75%, 75-100%) to determine if models disproportionately favor and focus on early context segments.
